mechanistic_claim_tested: mTOR is an ovary-specific aging pathway in humans
key_finding: mTOR signaling is a prominent ovary-specific aging pathway; CEBPD TF activity enhanced across aged ovarian cell types; ANM genetic variants integrated into regulatory networks
context: Human ovary snRNA/snATAC; 4 young (23-29y) vs 4 aged (49-54y)
confidence_and_limitations: n=8; transcript/chromatin abundance not kinase activity; associative not causal; RICTOR (mTORC2) is the validated gene

mechanistic_claim_tested: mTORC1 drives global primordial-follicle activation; mTORC1 inhibition preserves reserve
key_finding: Oocyte Pten loss raises PI3K-Akt and mTORC1; mTORC1-specific rapamycin prevents global follicle activation and preserves reserve
confidence_and_limitations: Genetic model of extreme activation (Pten null), not physiologic aging; mouse

evidence_type: model organism + human tissue in vitro
mechanistic_claim_tested: Chronic vs acute mTOR activation have opposite outcomes
key_finding: Chronic PI3K/mTOR activation exhausts follicle pool; acute activation permits fertility; mTOR stimulators activate primordial follicles in mouse and human cortex
confidence_and_limitations: In vitro activation assay; supports schedule-dependence (bidirectional)

mechanistic_claim_tested: Chemotherapy depletes reserve via PI3K burnout activation
key_finding: Cyclophosphamide activates quiescent primordial follicles ('burnout'); AS101 blocks activation and preserves reserve
confidence_and_limitations: Chemo model not natural aging; demonstrates activation-mediated depletion

key_finding: Cisplatin lowers PTEN, activates AKT/FOXO3a, overactivates dormant follicles, depletes reserve
confidence_and_limitations: Chemo model; mechanistically consistent with mTOR-axis activation

mechanistic_claim_tested: Transient mTOR inhibition extends ovarian lifespan; chronic harms
key_finding: 2-week rapamycin preserves primordial follicles, improves oocyte quality and microenvironment, extends ovarian lifespan; long-term rapamycin harms follicle development/ovulation
confidence_and_limitations: Mouse; benefit is schedule-dependent; transient disturbance of fertility during dosing

mechanistic_claim_tested: mTOR inhibition suppresses primordial-follicle growth in human tissue
key_finding: Rapamycin suppresses follicle growth from primordial stage in human ovarian cortical xenografts; reversible; oocyte developmental potential preserved
context: Human cortical fragments in immune-deficient mice

mechanistic_claim_tested: mTOR/PI3K activation drives human follicle activation; rapamycin suppresses PI3K arm
key_finding: In human cortex, cyclophosphamide upregulates PI3K signalling and follicle activation; rapamycin attenuates PI3K-signalling upregulation; AMH attenuates both damage and activation
column8: In vitro culture 24h; rapamycin did not block direct damage, only activation; AMH is a parallel regulator

key_finding: Oocyte-specific Rictor (mTORC2) ablation causes POF: follicular death, reserve loss, via reduced p-Akt(S473)/p-Foxo3a and raised Bax/Bad/PARP
confidence_and_limitations: Loss-of-function opposite direction to 'less mTOR=better'; mTORC2 arm; mouse

mechanistic_claim_tested: Menopause timing is set by DNA damage response genes
key_finding: 44 ANM loci; major enrichment in DDR genes incl first common BRCA1 coding variant; MR: later ANM->breast cancer via estrogen exposure
column8: mTOR not a primary signal; associative; ancestry-limited

mechanistic_claim_tested: Rare DDR variants set menopause timing
key_finding: Rare damaging variants in 5 genes (incl CHEK2) associate with ANM
confidence_and_limitations: mTOR-pathway genes not among top; ancestry-limited

mechanistic_claim_tested: DNA mismatch repair sets menopause timing
key_finding: MSH6 variant rs1800932 associates with ANM and MSH6 expression

mechanistic_claim_tested: Ovarian aging involves stromal fibrosis and inflammation
key_finding: Age-associated ovarian collagen I/III fibrosis, raised hydroxyproline, multinucleated macrophage giant cells
confidence_and_limitations: Microenvironment axis; mouse; correlative with age

key_finding: Aged/post-reproductive ovary shifts to immune-dominant signature, T-cell/macrophage/giant-cell infiltration, pro-inflammatory secretion
confidence_and_limitations: Bulk RNA + histology; inflammaging axis parallel to follicle depletion

mechanistic_claim_tested: Chronic mTOR hyperactivation as central ovarian-aging driver
key_finding: Review frames chronic mTOR hyperactivation driving ribosome biogenesis, impaired proteostasis/autophagy, mito dysfunction in aging oocytes; proposes pentadecanoic acid as safer modulator (molecular docking only)
confidence_and_limitations: Review + unvalidated in-silico docking; orientation only

mechanistic_claim_tested: Nutrient-sensing pathways regulate primordial follicle pool
key_finding: PI3K/PTEN/AKT/FOXO3 and TSC/mTOR central to primordial follicle maintenance; IGF-1/GH, transsulfuration, sirtuins also implicated
confidence_and_limitations: Review; orientation; names multiple parallel nutrient-sensing inputs

key_finding: Low-dose rapamycin delays ovarian aging in women
context: VIBRANT: randomized double-blind placebo-controlled pilot; registration only, no results located in PubMed as of 2026-10-18
